description_en: Allows a Resource Access Management (RAM) user to invoke ChangePassword to change their own console logon password
description_zh: RAM用户调用ChangePassword修改自己的控制台登录密码
name: ChangePassword

parameters.help_en: The old console logon password of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.help_zh: RAM用户的控制台登录旧密码
parameters.name: old_password

parameters.help_en:
The new console logon password of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The password must meet the password strength requirements. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28739.html
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录新密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28739.html。
parameters.name: new_password
